regions.today: A cold and crisp start this morning with a little cloud and some lingering light showers quickly clearing away. Sunny spells and dry weather developing throughout this afternoon with light winds. Feeling a little chilly with highs of 6 to 9 degrees.
regions.tonight: Largely dry tonight with plenty of clears spells and rather light winds. Feeling cold overnight again with lows of 0 to 3 degrees and some mist or fog patches forming too.
regions.tomorrow: Another cold start with any patchy mist quickly clearing. A little cloud will develop later in the morning with a southerly breeze. Becoming a little windier later overall but staying mostly dry. Highs of 8 to 12 degrees.
